Pincer Snap.name: Pincer Snap
Pincer Snap.description: The user's hand swells into the claw of a crab, lobster or shrimp they have eaten and snaps shut on a target within reach. It deals slashing damage; held back, the claw clamps a wrist or ankle without cutting, and the target cannot pull that limb free until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.
